import unittest
from decimal import Decimal
from unittest.mock import Mock
from payments import charge

class CurrencyBoundaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_eur_forwarded_without_conversion(self):
        adapter = Mock()
        amount = Decimal('12.34')
        result = charge(adapter, amount, 'EUR')
        adapter.charge.assert_called_once_with(amount=amount, currency='EUR')
        self.assertIs(adapter.charge.call_args.kwargs['amount'], amount)
        self.assertIs(result, adapter.charge.return_value)

    def test_usd_forwarding_unchanged(self):
        adapter = Mock()
        charge(adapter, 1234, 'USD')
        adapter.charge.assert_called_once_with(amount=1234, currency='USD')

    def test_provider_rejection_propagates(self):
        adapter = Mock()
        error = ValueError('Unsupported currency EUR')
        adapter.charge.side_effect = error
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as caught:
            charge(adapter, 1234, 'EUR')
        self.assertIs(caught.exception, error)

    def test_unknown_currency_also_forwarded(self):
        adapter = Mock()
        charge(adapter, 1234, 'UNKNOWN')
        adapter.charge.assert_called_once_with(amount=1234, currency='UNKNOWN')

unittest.main(verbosity=2)
